pages.text: Four Ender Markers outline the dig area for the Ender Quarry or Ender Thermic Pump.$(br2)Put adjacent corners on the same X or Z coordinate. Keep the four markers at the same height, with at least one block inside the rectangle.
Craft enough markers for four corners. Right-click the one your machine will touch.

pages.title: Link a Corner
pages.text: The scan checks up to 512 blocks along each axis. It reports the coordinates of the corners it finds and ends with $(thing)State: Complete$() when the rectangle is valid.$(br2)Move stray nearby markers out of the scan lines if they are picked up first.
